atoms.a: When Christopher Columbus arrived in America, he called the indigenous people “Indians”.
atoms.sound: When Christopher Columbus arrived in America, he called the indigenous people Indians.

atoms.a: Why did Christopher Columbus call the indigenous people “Indians”?
atoms.sound: Why did Christopher Columbus call the indigenous people Indians?
b: ++He thought he was in India, not America.
He liked the name so much.

atoms.b: After the discovery of the new continent ((++America India)), leaders of different countries in Europe sent people there to establish ((++colonies schools)).
A lot of ((++native old)) people weren’t happy about that because the ((++colonisers explorers)) brought laws and religions and forced them onto the indigenous people.
That ((++was_not was)) the only reason why the indigenous people weren’t happy.
Because more and more people from ((++Europe Africa)) came to America, the colonisers needed more space and ((++forced kindly_asked)) the indigenous people to give up their land.
